subject: 🩺 Specialist referral created - $specialty (Ref #$referral_id)
body:
Dear $student_name,

A specialist referral has been created for you by $referring_provider. This email confirms what has been recorded; you do not need to do anything yet unless one of the next steps below applies to you.

=== YOUR REFERRAL ===
Reference Number: $referral_id
Specialty: $specialty
Specialist: $specialist_provider
Referring Provider: $referring_provider
Urgency: $urgency
Date Referred: $referral_date
Current Status: $status

=== REASON FOR REFERRAL ===
$reason

=== ADDITIONAL NOTES ===
$notes

$urgency_notice

=== WHAT HAPPENS NEXT ===
1. The specialist service reviews your referral.
2. You will be contacted to arrange an appointment.
3. You will receive another email whenever the status of this referral changes.

Typical waiting times depend on the urgency above. If your symptoms get worse while you are waiting, contact the Health Centre — do not wait for the appointment.

=== IF SOMETHING IS WRONG ===
If any detail above is incorrect, or you did not expect this referral, contact the Health Centre quoting reference $referral_id.

=== CONTACT INFORMATION ===
Health Centre: health@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM
Out of hours emergencies: call 999

Best regards,
University Health Centre

$signature
